title: Our Teacher and Classmate
text:
Our teacher is Mr. Brown. He is tall and friendly. He is very patient with children. He smiles every day.

My classmate Maria is quiet. She sits by the window. She is very careful with her work. Her drawings are beautiful.

questions.text: How is Mr. Brown with children?
Why is Maria probably good at drawing?
options: She is careful with her work
She is always in a hurry

questions.text: How do the children probably feel with Mr. Brown?

vocabulary.definition: able to wait or stay calm without getting angry
kind and easy to talk to
not making much noise or not talking a lot
paying attention so that you do not make mistakes

paragraph_translations: Наш вчитель — пан Браун. Він високий і привітний. Він дуже терплячий з дітьми. Він щодня усміхається.
Моя однокласниця Марія тиха. Вона сидить біля вікна. Вона дуже уважна до своєї роботи. Її малюнки гарні.
